_meta.purpose: The single source for employment history. The résumé, the About page and the homepage timeline strip all render from here, so a promotion is recorded once.
_meta.rule: `title` is the title actually held during the period. Never a target title, never an aspirational one.

roles.title: Senior QA Automation Engineer
roles.summary: Sole QA on a multi-region digital health AI platform. I own quality strategy, release governance, the evaluation frameworks and the data platform function across six-plus concurrent AI product lines.
highlights: Own the production evaluation pipeline that samples live traffic and judges it against clinical safety and quality criteria.
Own the golden-dataset evaluation framework across four country programs and three distinct generation architectures.
Scrum Master since April 2025, concurrently with the QA and analytics ownership.
roles.note: A title promotion with continuous scope, not a new mandate. Most of the work that justified it was built during the preceding role and is credited there.

roles.title: QA Engineer
roles.summary: Led quality strategy and test automation for the platform. QA consolidated to a single engineer in October 2025; I have been the only QA on the project since.
highlights: Built the platform's first LLM-as-a-judge, then diagnosed it as structurally unreliable and rebuilt it around an independent judge model, binary verdicts and a calibrated criteria set.
Migrated UI automation off Robot Framework to Playwright after four of the framework's limits turned out to be structural rather than fixable.
Introduced consumer-driven contract testing, which caught a safety-classification refactor that every schema check had passed.
Built the production monitoring and evaluation pipeline, which surfaced a clinical-safety gap four independent testing layers had missed.
Primary QA contact in regular engagements with the client's CTO and CEO.

roles.title: Associate QA Engineer
roles.summary: Built the project's QA infrastructure from zero: the first structured process, the first UI automation, the first API suite, and the first CI integration.
highlights: Co-built the team's first QA process: test case templates, coverage matrices, severity standards and defect governance.
Built the first UI automation suite in Robot Framework and the first API suite in Pytest.
Took the full regression suite from a serial three-hour run to 39 minutes by consolidating login to one session per worker, which also fixed a race condition between parallel workers.

roles.title: Project Intern
roles.summary: Manual functional, integration and API testing during the platform's early NLP chatbot phase. Converted to full time on 2 May 2022.
highlights: Documented response inconsistencies, routing failures and edge-case behaviour for intent classification and NER flows.

education.institution: Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel Institute of Technology, Vasad

_markersRule: The homepage strip. It shows the progression, so the labels are the titles actually held plus the one scope change that happened without one. Five is the hard cap: at 64em the strip is repeat(auto-fit, minmax(11rem, 1fr)) with a --space-l gap, so six tracks need about 1256px against a 1200px band and the sixth wraps to a second row, where there is no spine to sit on. Scrum Master is deliberately not here; leadership is covered on /about/ and /resume/.
